s: Din halvaa beyom tob ubo b' seipim: chenvani hammaqqip mine maakal umishteh beyom tob — yakol litboa otam lemachar bedin sheyyipreu lo.

Gabbae tzedaqa gobin mehachatzerot mine maakal umishteh beyom tob kedarkan bechol, ella shello yakrizu kederek shehen makrizin bechol, shehare epshar ligbot belo hakraza, ella gobin betzina venotenin letok cheqam, umechalleqin lekol shekuna ushekuna bipne atzmah.
